vectors.harness: Start a StreamReveal for the case's source (cloud or onDevice). Replay events and probes in time order, an event before a probe at the same time. An event calls arrive(text, atMs) or finish(); a probe calls frame(atMs) and compares the shown prefix and fadeFrom. frame() is called only at probe times. Texts are ASCII, so offsets are characters on both platforms.
vectors.rule: A paragraph is the text between blank lines; a fenced block counts as one, and a paragraph's end includes the blank line that closes it. A paragraph is held for holdMs from its first arrived character; the answer's first paragraph (the one starting at offset 0) for firstHoldMs instead, or onDeviceFirstHoldMs when the case's source is onDevice. If it completes in that time it is shown whole and fades in over fadeMs (fadeFrom = its start). Otherwise the reveal starts: the first frame after the hold takes exactly one step, and later frames take floor(elapsed / stepMs) steps from the last step. A step moves the shown end ceil(deficit / divisor) characters, then forward to the end of the word it lands in (before the following whitespace), when that end has arrived. A trailing word still arriving holds the shown end at the last whitespace until partialWaitMs after the reveal first ran into it, then shows to the arrived end. A paragraph that completes after some of it was shown snaps whole without a fade; a new paragraph's arrival completes the one before it. The end of the stream shows everything.
